goal: bn-full: new game, seed 103, normal start, about 5 minutes: contextual HUD, unlock cards, Next line, Journal, overlays.

findings.title: Old tutorial tip contradicts the Next line
findings.detail: 'Tip 3 of 5: Gather stone' shows while Next says 'Create or join a nation'. Later 'Tip 4 of 5: Found a settlement' says 'Press N to start a nation' after the nation already exists. The 5-step tip track and the Next line/unlock cards are two tutorials at once.

findings.title: Toasts and cards show together and overlap HUD boxes
findings.detail: After founding, the status toast covers the 'Carrying ...' box (cut at 'saplings') while a News card covers the settlement nameplate. At the start, the Welcome toast and the Tip card show together.

findings.title: Nations unlock card arrives before the Next line asks for it
findings.detail: With Next still 'Gather wood - Wood 5/10', the 'Nations: start a nation of your own, or join one' card and the Create/Join buttons appear. That is sensible, but it pulls a step ahead of the Next line.

findings.title: Top-strip meters are low-contrast when idle
findings.detail: The energy, apple and coin meters render grey-on-grey (e.g. '97' and '0') until they change.

findings.title: Journal goal track markers are misaligned
findings.detail: On the Goals page, the second completed marker sits below the progress line, out of line with the others.

metrics.unlockOrder: (empty) -> Nations card + Create/Join after first wood -> Eat Apple -> Found Settlement card after nation -> Enter/Teleport/Plant after founding

verdict: The first bar starts empty and unlocks in a sensible order. The Next line is clear and the picture Journal reads well (Goals tile detail, Era and Nation pages). The 'one overlay at a time' promise does not hold: toasts stack with cards and with each other, and the old 5-tip track still runs beside the new Next line.
